name: XP & Leveling From The Start
description: Sets the AllowXPBar profile flag true as each chapter loads, so Lex's level-up bar is active from chapter 1.1. Normally it is unlocked by a scripted conversation partway through Book 1 (Tutorial.XPConvPanelDone); this turns it on immediately. Leveling awards one stat per level, cycling every three: level 1/4/7/10... = +1 heart (and a full heal), 2/5/8/11... = +12.5% attack power, 3/6/9/12... = +1 defense. Pair this with Disable Cutscene Dialog, which skips the unlock conversation.
author: you
